text:
Alex: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Alex: What I did: bumped EU-AZ headroom + adjusted autoscaler policy for the new batch jobs (min=3 -> 4). Verified canary traffic routing.
Alex: Blockers: noticed a couple of drain failures on spot nodegroup eu-west-1b when we preempted. See minimal log below.
```
I0318 09:12:44 kubelet.go:123] error draining node: timeout waiting for pods to terminate
... eviction-controller: pod termination hook failed
```
Alex: Today: iterate on drain timeout fix, push patch to autoscaler config, and run a 30m canary after PR merges.

Maria: saw queue latency spike ~09:10 UTC too. Might be correlated with the model rollout (mosaic-7b). I rolled back the routing rule for canary.

Jin: pushed PR #842 to extend drain timeout and add retry for eviction-hook. PTAL @Leo @Alex — small change.
Jin: link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/842

Sam: heads-up — traffic for internal perf tests will peak at 11:00 UTC. Can we keep headroom at +1 GPU for eu-west for next 2h?

Alex: @Sam ok, I'll hold headroom at 5 for next 2 hours.

Ops-bot: [alert] spot-eviction eu-west-1b detected 2026-03-18T09:11:38Z — 4 nodes reclaimed :warning:
Ops-bot: related incidents: INC-3321 (auto-created)

Leo: reviewing PR now. If tests pass I'll merge and start the canary at +10m after merge.

Harpreet: filed quota ticket Q-1138 to temporarily increase reserved capacity for eu-west-1 for the sprint-day — ETA ops approval 2h. Added justification (perf tests).

Tayla: for oncall ops note — can we add a fallback model route to smaller quantized variants when spot fallback triggers? reduces latency spikes. happy to write the routing policy.

Alex: +1 to fallback route. @Tayla can you draft a policy and I'll slot it into the canary?

Maria: small ask — can we get a short blurb for CS to explain the rollback (they pinged). I can draft if you give root cause summary.

Alex: root cause summary: spot eviction in eu-west-1b triggered concurrent node drains; drain timeout was too short for our eviction hooks, leading to transient queue backlog and model rollout pressure. Fix = extend drain timeout + retry hook + temporary headroom.

Leo: merged PR #842 at 09:32 UTC, starting canary in 5m.

Jin: added unit + integration test for eviction-hook retry.

Sam: noted, thanks. I'll pause the perf ramp until canary green.

Harpreet: ops approved Q-1138, capacity added.

Tayla: policy draft uploaded to infra/routing/policies/fallback-quant.json, pinged in PR description.

Alex: thanks all — will post quick postmortem if canary shows instability. Otherwise i'll close this thread after canary window. :thumbsup:
